title: Product of copies of a Noetherian ring is flat Mittag-Leffler
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $A$ be any set. The product module $R^A=\prod_{a\in A}R$, with componentwise $R$-module operations, is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and is a Mittag-Leffler $R$-module [def-trf-mittag-leffler-module].

mathlib_searches.query: the product of an arbitrary set of copies of a Noetherian ring is flat and Mittag Leffler as a module
mathlib_searches.results: isNoetherian_prod, isNoetherian_pi, isNoetherian_pi'; no module Flat/Mittag-Leffler result for arbitrary products.
isNoetherian_pi and finite-product declarations only; no flat and tensor-product Mittag-Leffler theorem.

from.place: Tag 05DJ proof, final two sentences: Noetherian implies coherent, so the arbitrary product is flat, and the product-of-copies lemma gives Mittag-Leffler.
